lines.en: - Okay, all right, so now you go.
- No, I don't wanna tell you.
- Why not?
- 'Cause it's embarrassing.
- More embarrassing than shiny raspberry lip balm?
I didn't say raspberry before, did I?
Just tell me, Ray, just tell me.
- Okay, all right, stand up.
Well, when we're at the door,
I lightly press my lips against his.
And then move into his body just for a second.
And then I make this sound.
Mmm.
Okay, I know it didn't sound like anything,
but I swear it works.
- Yeah, well, yeah, that would work, yeah.
- All right, I gotta go to bed.
Honey, I had such a wonderful time.
- Oh, yeah.
- Me too.
